pending: The new command-player context identifies the authenticated sender, but this port accepts invitation targets as UUID text because Horizon has no online-player lookup or tab completion API for target resolution.
The chat capability only shows a message to the local player; there is no party-targeted or server-broadcast chat operation.
Membership is keyed by player UUID inside mod-scoped storage; there is no transactional per-player storage namespace or cross-server team model.
FTB Teams alliances and chunk claims are not implemented; Horizon has no claim ownership, protection, or ally-access API for this port.
Positive invitation acceptance by a second authenticated player and guest identity are not validated in multiplayer.
